records.data: Asahi total-frame intervals in ms. Baseline cards omit the main mod; candidate A controls have ShaderLOD installed and MasterOff. Cross-process baseline/card differences are not a causal mod-overhead estimate. Initial unrepaired MakeUp/BSL diagnostic baselines excluded. A measured request is not automatically proven active or beneficial. Cells without valid measurements have no invented bars.

Frame sample SD/variance describes jitter within a window. Process/window-mean SD/variance describes repeated-window or repeated-process variation. Equal weighting of runs/windows; no independent-frame inference or confidence intervals.

Per process:100*(A-B)/A, A=(first native window mean + last native window mean)/2; B is the candidate window mean, or mean of both candidate-window means in ABBA/BAAB. Repeated effects are equally weighted process effects; SD is in percentage points.
Analysis drift is100*(last native mean-first native mean)/first native mean. Native windows are inner A windows in BAAB; no chronological native/candidate/native claim for balanced orders.

Within-window variance uses N-1 frame samples in ms squared; SD is its square root. Plot bars average within-window SD when combining windows/processes. Main chart between-process variance separates A0/B/A1; CSV native role averages both native windows within each process. n1 between-process variance is unavailable.

native.scope: Untimed 20s camera path, six lossless native framebuffer samples per second. Native animation/history advance. Readback and PNG writing can stall rendering; no timing or exact deterministic pixel parity claim.

candidate.scope: Untimed 20s camera path, six lossless native framebuffer samples per second. Native animation/history advance. Readback and PNG writing can stall rendering; no timing or exact deterministic pixel parity claim.
